page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, mixing Latin with Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac type, running from top to bottom. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored. Running head at top, page number at top right. A Hebrew catchword sits at the lower right.

main_text.p: עַוְיָא, עַוְיָא Ch. Iniquitas, perversitas. Plur. עַוְיִן emphat. עַוְיָתָא, & עַוְיִן.
עַוְתָא, עַאתָא, עַאתָא & עַוָּא Ch. Idem.
עַיִּך Syr. Impedivit, obstitit. Praet. cum Aff.
Impedivit me Satanas, 1.ad Thess. 2.18. Vide notas Tremellii.
עָוַל Hebr. Iniquè, perversè agere. Hinc Syr. Aphel Praet. Iniquè egimus, defraudavimus, 2. ad Cor. 7.2. Partic. Non iniquè ago contra te, Matth.20.13.
עוּלָא עָוְל Ch. & Syr. Iniquus, perversus. Plural. עוּלִין,
Ch. Idem. Plur. עוּלָאֵי, עוּלָאִין Prov.29.18.
עוּלְתָא עוּלָא Ch. & Syr. Iniquitas, perversitas.
עֵילָא & עֵיל עוּלָא Ch. Pullus, pullus asini, asellus: Sic & Syr. Matth.21.2.5. Infans, puer, Lucae 1.41. & cap. 2.12.16. Plur. עֵילִין Judic.12.14. & עֵילִין Jesa.30.6.
עִיּול Ch. Pulvis tenuissimus, Hebr. שחק Jesa.40.15.
עוֹן עָנָא עָנָן & עָנָא עוֹן Ch. & Syr. Grex, greges, oves, pecus. Plur. Syr. Matth.26.31. Luc.17.7. &c. Ab Hebraeo עֵין, commutatis pro more r & y.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac type is approximated and several vowel-pointed words may be wrong. Syriac forms and the reference marks in the entries (for example the superscript letters) are hard to read at this scan resolution. Show-through of the reverse page is not transcribed.
